title: Cover Search
description: A music search field over your top songs and the Beatles catalogue. Every keystroke answers at once: a top result, the matching songs and the matching albums, with the matched letters picked out and new results fading in without anything flying around. Arrow keys walk the results, Enter plays.
intent: Search that feels instant and calm: results are laid out like a real music app's search page and settle in place on each keystroke instead of reshuffling.
